points.point: Article context shows enable Javascript and cookies message
points.sentence: Sometimes when you try to add a blog, article, or website as new context, you'll see a message related to "enabling Javascript and cookies".

points.point: Why it happens / what to do
points.sentence: This means Blotato's website scraper is unable to access the website due to its anti-scraping policies.

verdict.reason: The entry directly addresses the Javascript and cookies message when adding a blog or article as context, and explains the cause.
